architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

design_decisions: SVC-015 owns CorrespondentRelationship (ENT-075) as the MLR 2017 R34 compliance record.
SVC-015 calls SVC-014 (intra-CAP-005) for sanctions screening of correspondent bank.
SVC-015 publishes EVT-163 (CorrespondentEddCompleted) which triggers SVC-007 and SVC-010 to set up the nostro account and routing.
SVC-015 publishes EVT-164 (CorrespondentOnboarded) after nostro account and SWIFT channel are confirmed.

consumed_events.name: CorrespondentEddCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Intra-capability: set up ongoing AML monitoring for the new correspondent relationship

design_decisions: SVC-014 sanctions screening of the correspondent bank entity is an intra-capability call (SVC-014 and SVC-015 are both in CAP-005).

consumed_events.name: CorrespondentEddCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Create nostro account for the new correspondent relationship. Provision account with initial funding.

design_decisions: SVC-007 (CAP-002) creates the nostro account asynchronously after EVT-163 confirms EDD is complete and Senior Management has approved.

consumed_events.name: CorrespondentEddCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Register correspondent BIC in payment routing table. Enable the new currency corridor for international payments.

design_decisions: SVC-010 (CAP-003) registers the SWIFT BIC and enables the currency corridor asynchronously after EDD approval event.

consumed_events.name: CorrespondentEddCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable EDD completion record with SM approval attestation ref

cross_service_interaction_summary: SVC-015 (CAP-005) → EVT-163 → SVC-007 (CAP-002), SVC-010 (CAP-003): Cross-capability nostro account and routing setup after EDD approval
SVC-015 (CAP-005) → EVT-164 → SVC-103 (CAP-008): Onboarding audit record
